name: Razormaw Needling

angles.text: Howin Kindfeather shares the bitter hatred Wildhammer and Ironforge dwarves hold for the Dark Iron clan and the Dragonmaw orcs, who ravaged the Wetlands and Grim Batol.
Protective gear against dragonfire aids the Alliance's ongoing struggle against dragonkin and Dragonmaw forces holding the eastern marshes.

faq.answer: Howin Kindfeather gives the work in the Wetlands. He bears a deep grudge against the Dark Iron dwarves, the Dragonmaw clan, and the drakes they rode, and seeks to make armor from whelp scales to resist dragonfire.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Razormaw Needling?

aliases: why does howin want raptor teeth
faq.answer: Howin is making protective armor from tough dragon whelp scales, but their hide is difficult to stitch. Razormaw incisors are sharp and sturdy enough to make awls that pierce the scales without breaking.
faq.q: Why does Howin Kindfeather need Razormaw incisors?

faq.answer: Razormaw raptors prowl Raptor Ridge in the northeast Wetlands and Saltspray Glen in the northwest, toward the coast.
faq.q: Where are the Razormaw raptors located?

faq.answer: Howin is stitching dragon whelp scales into protective gear. The scales guard against fiery breath and offer protection from dragons and the Dragonmaw clan's drakes.
faq.q: What is Howin Kindfeather making with the whelp scales?

aliases: why hate dark irons and dragonmaw
faq.answer: Howin despises the Dark Iron clan and the Dragonmaw orcs, who enslaved red dragons during the Second War. The Wetlands and surrounding mountains bear scars from both factions, and Howin wants to redress the balance.
faq.q: Why does Howin hate the Dark Irons and Dragonmaw?

aliases: how are raptor teeth used as tools
faq.answer: Howin turns the raptor incisors into durable awls. Their natural taper lets them punch through tough hides and leather for sewing, and pierce dragon scales without snapping.
faq.q: What does Howin turn the raptor incisors into?

sections.body: Howin Kindfeather wants to strike back at the enemies who have plagued the Wetlands: the Dark Iron dwarves, the Dragonmaw orcs, and the drakes they brought into battle. He is assembling armor from dragon whelp scales to guard against dragonfire. Their hides are so tough that ordinary tools cannot sew them together.
sections.title: Tools of Retribution

sections.body: Howin needs sharp, sturdy tools to pierce the tough whelp hide. He looks to the Razormaw raptors that stalk Raptor Ridge in the northeast and Saltspray Glen in the northwest. Their needle-sharp incisors make strong awls, able to pierce dragon scales without shattering under pressure.
sections.title: Fangs as Needles

summary: In the Wetlands, Howin Kindfeather seeks teeth from the Razormaw raptors. He plans to make awls for stitching dragon whelp scales into armor that can resist flame.
